name: A Short Note
summary: A Short Note asks you to carry Daryn’s letter to Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris. It requests a picture of Gammerita, a giant snapjaw in the Hinterlands.

sections.title: A Letter for Curgle
sections.body: Daryn’s research keeps her in Rut’theran Village, though her latest fascination is the snapjaws on the Hinterlands beach. She wants a picture of Gammerita, a giant snapjaw, and sends you to Tanaris with a letter for Curgle Cranklehop. Curgle has made an invention that can capture a picture.

faq.answer: Daryn wrote the letter. She is a historian in Rut’theran Village whose latest fascination is the snapjaws of the Hinterlands.
Gammerita is a giant snapjaw on the beach in the Hinterlands. Daryn wants a picture of her.
Curgle Cranklehop is in Tanaris and has made an invention that can capture a picture.

faq.q: Why does Daryn want a picture?
faq.answer: Daryn wants a picture of Gammerita because she cannot leave her research in Rut’theran Village to see the giant snapjaw herself.
